jujitsu.definition: n a method of self-defense without weapons that was developed in China and Japan; holds and blows are supplemented by clever use of the attacker's own weight and strength
jujitsu.translation: [医] 柔术, 柔道(日本的一种武术)

juju.definition:
n. the power associated with a juju
n. a charm superstitiously believed to embody magical powers

jujube.definition:
n. spiny tree having dark red edible fruits
n. dark red plumlike fruit of Old World buckthorn trees
n. chewy fruit-flavored jellied candy (sometimes medicated to soothe a sore throat)

jujus.translation: （某些西非部族所用的）物神, 符咒( juju的名词复数 )

jujutsu.definition: n a method of self-defense without weapons that was developed in China and Japan; holds and blows are supplemented by clever use of the attacker's own weight and strength
